title: Patch: the Jlorious card back, owned only by reaching Jlorious
notes: R2755000: card-back-jlorious, a Mythic card back that no roll, cosmetic pack, token, Chase Shard bar, dev fill or ladder bot offers; a rated game grants it to each person it leaves Jlorious, and migration 0074 to everyone who held Jlorious before. On a card its emblem draws the J and star of the logo's front card and breathes.

player.title: The Jlorious card back
new: The Jlorious card back: the logo's gold J and star on a violet card. The only way to own it is to reach Jlorious, and it is yours to keep.
